response.query: Which member-checking protocols (opt-in summary review, anonymized group validation) minimize power dynamics and reputational risk while ensuring analytic credibility?
response.answer: Opt-in summary review and anonymized group validation minimize power dynamics and reputational risk while ensuring analytic credibility. These methods allow participants to verify findings without revealing identities. They enhance trustworthiness and accuracy.
